$comment: Signal operational failure boundaries. Expected outcomes (asking for results with questions still unanswered, a dimension with too few numeric answers to score) remain typed engine outcomes shown as ordinary page content and are not Aegis faults. See src/Echelon.Signal.Application/Boundary.fs.

boundaries.name: Limen engine message dispatch (assessment page)
boundaries.$comment: Every kernel message is parsed and dispatched inside Aegis.capture (Wire.handle). A message that is not the Limen shape the engine relies on, or that names an item or answer code the assessment does not define, is MESSAGE_INVALID. Programming defects (for example an event name index.html sends that the engine does not know) keep Aegis fail-loud semantics and surface as a Limen bridge error.

boundaries.name: Browser DOM, print, history navigation and clipboard
boundaries.$comment: Execution occurs browser-side (DOM projection, the browser's print, history.replaceState for the live URL). The engine requests two Limen effects, a Navigation replace (LURL-001) and a Clipboard writeText of the finalized submission link; their Failure outcomes are typed notices to the respondent, not Aegis faults, and a result for an effect the engine did not request (or already heard) is MESSAGE_INVALID at the dispatch boundary. This declaration does not pretend the .NET Aegis runtime guards JavaScript.

persistence.fallbackBehaviour: Aegis sink failures are contained by the configured fallback; Signal does not treat diagnostic persistence as business success.
persistence.retentionPolicy: No durable Aegis sink is configured; in the browser the standard-error sink writes to the console.
